lines.t: intro
(low drums, distant trumpet tone, deep male voice)
The sound is rising…
not all will listen.
not all will turn.
verse 1
there’s a fire in the Word when it’s spoken
not soft, not safely ignored
it cuts through stone, it splits the heart
like a sharpened two-edged sword
some hear hope in the sound of Truth
others feel the burn
the same flame that lights the path
is the fire that makes men turn
pre-chorus
you can’t stand still when the trumpet cries
you either bow — or you fight
every soul will answer once
when the dark collides with light
chorus
Heed the Call it’s ringing now
hear the warning in the sound
a Shout, a Witness, Truth proclaimed
no middle ground, no neutral ground
Heed the Call, repent, return
before the final fire burns
mercy calls you while it may
tomorrow’s not a promised day
verse 2
Words like fire upon the proud
foreheads marked with flame
tears will fall where hearts are pierced
when Truth exposes names
some are struck and rise again
washed, forgiven, clean
others clench their fists in rage
and curse what they have seen
pre-chorus 2
the blade is sharp, the hour is near
the line is clearly drawn
every lie will lose its grip
when the trumpet carries on
chorus
Heed the Call it’s ringing now
hear the warning in the sound
a Shout, a Witness, Truth proclaimed
no middle ground, no neutral ground
Heed the Call, repent, return
before the final fire burns
mercy calls you while it may
tomorrow’s not a promised day
bridge
this is not a whisper
this is not a tale
this is judgment mixed with grace
a choice that will not fail
The Word goes out, it will not fall
empty to the ground
it saves or it condemns
depending how it’s found
Heed the Call the trumpet cries
wake, arise, open your eyes
Truth has come, the door is near
Love still calls but so does fear
Heed the Call choose life today
turn your heart, don’t walk away
the fire speaks, The Word is true
the call is sounded what will you do
outro
(music fades, deep male narrator)
Therefore Hear The Word of The Lord…
and Heed the Call. a Shout to the nations
a Witness to all
a trumpet of alarm and war
Truth proclaimed, judgment drawn
repent, return, while mercy stands
for the day of The Lord comes in. for My Words are fire
and My Truth is light,refuse to repent, cling to rebellion
and stand condemned in the end
or fall to your knees and be made new
while mercy still extends. outro
(trumpet blast, fading thunder)
Therefore hear the Word of The Lord, and heed the call...
For it is a call to repentance, a shout
And a witness, a proclamation of Truth...
A trumpet of alarm and war, a declaration
Of judgment, a strong rebuke...
Says The Lord.
